To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the amplitude of the coupled RLC circuit system with nonlinear inductance and nonlinear resistance increases when voltage, plate area, and resistance R1 increase but decreases when plate distance, resistance, and R2 increase, while the nature frequency of coupled RLC system with nonlinear inductor and nonlinear resistance increases with plate distance but it decrease when the plate area or the linear inductance increases.

the amplitude and resonance regions of the system increase as the voltage, the plate area and resistance increase, while the amplitude and resonance region decrease as the plate distance, resistance and linear inductances increase.
the nonlinear vibration characteristics of coupled RLC circuits and spring systems with inductance nonlinearity and resistance nonlinearities are studied.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nonlinear vibration of coupled circuit and spring system.
a coupled nonlinear system, which is of great importance for the analysis of the nonlinear vibration of coupled electrical and mechanical systems.
a nonlinear vibration model of coupled RCL (Resistance-Induction-Capacitancy) circuit and spring systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 2nd superharmonic resonance of coupled RLC system with inductances and resistances nonlinearities is more complex than that of linear system.
the amplitude and frequency of the system increase as the plate area, voltage and linear inductances coefficient increase.
the nonlinear vibration characteristics are very complicated, which is affected not only by the system parameters, but also by the excitation parameters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the system has a second superharmonic resonance when the voltage, plate area, linear inductance coefficients and resistance R1 increase.
the nonlinear vibration of the system has been studied and the effects of the parameters of the system on its steady state responses have been discussed.
the amplitude of the steady state solution of the coupled RLC circuit system is not always the maximum value.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it provides a new way to study the nonlinear vibration of coupled spring system and RLC circuit with resistance and inductance nonlinearity.
the amplitude and nature frequency of the coupled RLC circuit system are affected by the parameters of the system.
the second harmonic response of the system can be controlled by adjusting the parameters of the circuit and spring system.
